Amethyst 1.16.0 brings BOLT12 offers into the profile payment rail and zap picker, adds a guarded BOLT11 fallback, and introduces a local My Fitness dashboard.

The payment fallback is intentionally conservative. It retries only errors that clearly reject the instruction, not timeouts or ambiguous payment failures where a second attempt could pay twice.

My Fitness combines Health Connect records with the user's own Nostr workout events and keeps its calculations on the device. Publishing remains optional.

The release also separates headless shared code from the Compose UI layer, reducing command-line dependencies and carrying a set of correctness and performance fixes.

There are limits worth reading: the BOLT12 fallback was not tested end to end with a live NWC wallet, store rollout is not proven by GitHub artifacts, and the fitness screen can miss relay-backed workouts on a cold start.
